# Hyprland 0.56.2 .socket2.sock bursts picked from the live capture (SOURCE.txt),
# applied in this order to the state in before/.

## title
# The focused terminal's title changes: Hyprland restates the active window.
windowtitle>>557a6df4c490
windowtitlev2>>557a6df4c490,◑ term one
activewindow>>com.mitchellh.ghostty,◑ term one
activewindowv2>>557a6df4c490

## switch
# Super+3: the active window first, then the workspace.
activewindow>>com.mitchellh.ghostty,top
activewindowv2>>557a6e37b040
workspace>>3
workspacev2>>3,3

## switch-back
# Super+1.
activewindow>>com.mitchellh.ghostty,◑ term one
activewindowv2>>557a6df4c490
workspace>>1
workspacev2>>1,1

## new-workspace
# Super+5: workspace 5 is created, the focus leaves every window, then the switch.
createworkspace>>5
createworkspacev2>>5,5
activewindow>>,
activewindowv2>>
workspace>>5
workspacev2>>5,5

## open
# A terminal opens there: its title and an urgent hint come before openwindow,
# then it takes the focus.
windowtitle>>557a6e504f50
windowtitlev2>>557a6e504f50,Ghostty
urgent>>557a6e504f50
openwindow>>557a6e504f50,5,com.mitchellh.ghostty,Ghostty
activewindow>>com.mitchellh.ghostty,Ghostty
activewindowv2>>557a6e504f50

## retitle
# Its shell sets the title.
windowtitle>>557a6e504f50
windowtitlev2>>557a6e504f50,user@host:~
activewindow>>com.mitchellh.ghostty,user@host:~
activewindowv2>>557a6e504f50
